It asks what comes next; the author picks Open the pull request next, and because the session holds about 97000 tokens, under the 150000 at which compacting pays, Claude names /ponderly:pr #111 as the next command and says how to switch anyway.

g.text: ponderly — bugfix
● ## Problems
- You, as the owner, paid more than I told you: I said one run of the `/clear` eval case, and the
harness runs each case three times. The four eval invocations cost $1.46 in total, where I had
implied about $0.12. Nothing is left to spend; this is for your accounting.
- A user on the installed plugin still sees the old sentence: the plugin version is still 1.10.0,
because I did not bump it. The fix reaches nobody until a version ships. Options: bump it in the
pull request, or hold it for a release you choose.
- You may assume the ticket's own steps were re-run, and they were not: the fix is proved by the
eval case, a typed command in a small sandbox session, not by `/ponderly:switch-task write me a
packing list…` in a session holding substantial work. The skill text read is the same in both, so
I expect the same result, which is inference. Options: accept the eval as proof, or try it in a
[redacted] tab with `--plugin-dir`.
## Done
- **Root cause, as you confirmed:** step 3 of the `switch-task` skill built the `/clear` message
by keeping everything from "Then run:" on, which carried the `/compact` form's closing sentence
into it.
- **Fix:** the `/clear` form now has its own whole template in step 3, ending "You can skip the
clear and run the next step as it is." The `/compact` template is untouched. A first attempt that
only added an exception sentence made the model drop the closing sentence in 2 of 3 runs, so I
replaced it with the full template.
- **Regression test:** a new grader on the `clears-for-unrelated-work` eval case expects that
exact sentence. It failed 3 of 3 runs before the fix and passes 3 of 3 after, with the case's
other six graders passing throughout.
- **Reference doc:** the `switch-task` section of `docs/reference.md` now says the `/clear`
message ends by saying you can skip the clear.
- **Left alone on purpose:** `docs/guides/build-a-feature.md` quotes the old sentence in a
`/compact` example, where it is right. The merged spec `compact-at-task-switch` is a record.
## Checks
- `make eval-skill-switch-task EVAL_ARGS="--case clears-for-unrelated-work"`: passes, 3 of 3
runs, all seven graders.
- `make eval-skill-switch-task EVAL_ARGS="--case writes-the-compact-line"`: passes, 3 of 3 runs,
and all three replies still end "You can skip the compaction and run the next step as it is."
- `make validate`: passes.
- The other three `switch-task` cases, which test the offer and not the message, were not run.
## Files
- `plugins/claude/ponderly/skills/switch-task/SKILL.md`
- `evals/skills/switch-task/clears-for-unrelated-work/graders/says-the-clear-can-be-skipped.md`
- `docs/reference.md`
## Next
